title: sync script: .beads worktree writes by the LLM session are ungated; corrupted store can be committed by post-loop checkpoints
description: Reviewer kimi-k3 pass 2.2. The prompt-level 'do not touch .beads/' (:110) is not enforced: nothing detects the session writing .beads/** directly in main's worktree during the 900s window. snapshot_store (:301) preserves the corrupted state and post-loop checkpoints (:332-346) commit it into main's history. Fix: snapshot 'git status --porcelain .beads/' (or store tree hash) pre-session and require unchanged post-session.
